cases.subject: I was charged twice for my subscription
cases.body: Hi support, I was billed twice on July 1 for my Pro plan ($49). Transaction IDs: ch_123 and ch_456. Please refund the duplicate charge.

cases.subject: App keeps crashing when I export CSV
cases.body: Every time I click Export on the reports page the mobile app freezes. iPhone 15, iOS 18.2, app version 3.4.1. Happens on Wi-Fi and LTE.

cases.subject: Enterprise pricing for 120 seats
cases.body: We're evaluating your platform for 120 users. Do you offer annual enterprise pricing, SSO (SAML), and a dedicated success manager?

cases.subject: Requesting a refund within 14-day window
cases.body: I purchased the annual plan 5 days ago and realized it doesn't fit our workflow. Please process a full refund per your 14-day policy.

cases.subject: Where can I find my invoices?
cases.body: Hello! Can you point me to where I can download past invoices from the dashboard?
